description: Vietnamese multi-dialect speech dataset covering the fine-grained diversity of 63 provincial dialects instead of the coarse three-region grouping, built from local news broadcasts and supporting dialect identification and speech recognition.

region.description: Macro dialect region of the speaker, which the card lists as Northern / Central / Southern; the coarse grouping contrasted with the 63 provincial dialects.

province_code.description: Numeric code of the speaker's province, declared by the card as bookkeeping for province_name; the bare number is not an audio-understanding answer.

province_name.description: Name of the province, defining the specific provincial dialect of the speaker; the fine-grained counterpart of region.

filename.description: Name of the source audio file for this row; bookkeeping only, not a semantic speech attribute.

text.description: Transcript of the utterance, semi-automatically transcribed and manually verified.

speakerID.description: Anonymized speaker identifier; usable only to relate rows of the same speaker, and its literal value must never become a semantic answer.

gender.description: Speaker gender as an encoded integer. The source card states no meaning for the integer values, so no numeric-to-label reading may be assumed and the field stays out of the final QA pool until an encoding policy exists.

audio.description: Waveform audio of the utterance; acoustic input evidence only and never a direct semantic gold answer.

relations.description: The card contrasts the 63 provincial dialects named by province_name with the coarse three-region grouping named by region, making province_name the finer-grained label of the pair.
filename names the source audio file that carries the waveform stored in audio for the same row.

qa_constraints: Use only the raw field names declared by the source card; never rename or invent a field.
Do not expose a literal speakerID value as a semantic answer; the field may only relate rows of the same speaker.
Do not treat filename as a semantic speech attribute.
Do not assign any meaning to the gender encoding; the card leaves the integer meaning undefined.
Do not treat the numeric province code as an audio-understanding answer; province_name is the labelled dialect field.
Do not publish a province-to-region lookup table; that mapping needs row-level data not present in the card.
Every gold answer must be derivable deterministically from the declared fields or from card-stated relations.
